full_description: Swap the complete initial poses of the two T-shaped blocks, including both position and orientation.
preference: Clarify complete-pose exchange and final release conditions without prescribing an arm, coordinate, grasp, or motion path.
seen: At the start, identify the two T-shaped blocks and remember both the position and orientation of each block. Swap their complete poses: place each T-block at the other T-block's original position and match the other block's original orientation. At completion, both T-blocks must be released, stable on the table, and no longer held by either gripper.
